name: Neo4j
desc: Property graph DB with Cypher; native vector search; Aura Agent + MCP server for graph-as-memory. $100M GenAI investment in 2025.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Community/Enterprise self-managed; Neo4j Aura cloud

name: Ontotext GraphDB / Graphwise
desc: RDF graph database with real-time inference, now a component of the Graphwise Platform. Ontotext and Semantic Web Company (PoolParty) joined forces as Graphwise in 2024; Oakley Capital took a majority stake in 2026.
deployment: Both

name: Palantir Ontology
desc: Proprietary operational ontology — semantic objects + kinetic actions wired to microservices. Not open-standards KG; closed platform.
deployment: Both

name: Stardog
desc: RDF-native semantic platform with SHACL validation, virtual graphs, and the Voicebox AI assistant. $32.5M funding. Pitches itself as a governed-knowledge layer.
deployment: Both
pricing: Stardog Free (renewable 1-year license, commercial use allowed, no HA/caching/backups); Enterprise on-prem and cloud quote-based

name: TigerGraph
desc: Parallel graph DB with GSQL/GQL. CoPilot for entity extraction. Free community edition.
deployment: Both
pricing: Community Edition free; Savanna free trial; Savanna $45 per GB/month and Savanna Business Critical $126 per GB/month (24x7, US/Tier 1); Enterprise via sales

name: TopQuadrant (TopBraid EDG)
desc: Ontology-native semantic governance suite (formerly TopBraid EDG, now TQ Data Foundation) built on RDF, OWL and SHACL; serves governed context to agents via MCP, a Python SDK and REST.
deployment: Both (on-prem + Azure Marketplace SaaS)
pricing: Enterprise only — modular packages (Metadata Mgmt, Reference Data Mgmt, Vocabulary Mgmt, Business Glossaries)

name: Algolia
desc: Search-as-a-service API for instant search experiences — NeuralSearch (vector) + lexical. Adopted by 12000+ companies including LVMH, Stripe.
deployment: Managed-only — hosted search-as-a-service API
license: proprietary (hosted SaaS); open-source API clients/codegen are MIT

name: OpenSearch
desc: AWS-led fork of Elasticsearch 7 — Apache-licensed; k-NN plugin, OpenSearch ML, neural-search. Substrate beneath AWS OpenSearch Service.
deployment: searched not found
pricing: free (OSS); Amazon OpenSearch Service billed separately by AWS

name: Quickwit
desc: Open-source distributed search engine for logs/traces — cloud-native (object storage as primary tier). Acquired by Datadog 2024.
deployment: Self-hosted only — OSS distributed search engine on object storage

name: Sajari (now Search.io)
desc: Site-search platform (formerly Sajari) with the Neuralsearch vector engine. Acquired by Algolia in September 2022 and folded into Algolia's hybrid search; search.io now redirects to algolia.com.
deployment: searched not found

name: Supabase Vector
desc: Supabase's managed pgvector — combined Postgres + vector store; popular default for OSS LLM apps. Supabase $80M Series C 2024.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Supabase Cloud or self-hosted Supabase stack
license: Apache-2.0 (Supabase stack); vectors via pgvector (PostgreSQL licence)

name: Tantivy
desc: Rust port of Lucene — embedded full-text search engine. Underlies Quickwit, Lnx, Bayard. Used in Meilisearch and many in-process search engines.
deployment: Self-hosted only — embedded Rust full-text search library

name: Typesense
desc: Open-source search engine focused on typo-tolerance and ease of use — Typesense Cloud commercial; rising Algolia alternative.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS server; Typesense Cloud

name: Vald
desc: Yahoo Japan's open-source distributed vector search engine — built on NGT; Kubernetes-native; horizontal scaling.
deployment: Self-hosted only — Kubernetes-native distributed vector search engine

name: Activeloop Deep Lake
desc: Deep Memory feature optimises embedding space per use-case (+22% retrieval accuracy). Deep Lake PG unifies serverless Postgres (agent short-term state) + billion-scale vector search (long-term memory).
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Apache-2.0 library and managed Deeplake cloud; Enterprise runs in your own VPC
pricing: Hivemind Basic $0/month ($15 credits; 150k traces and 1.5M queries included, then $0.25 per 1k traces and 10k queries); Team $99/seat/month; Enterprise custom (

name: Chroma
desc: Limited native hybrid (users build RRF custom). Fast Rust core (v2.5).
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS embedded/server; Chroma Cloud serverless; single-tenant/BYOC on Enterprise
pricing: Starter $0 + usage ($5 free credits); Team $250/mo + usage ($100 credits); Enterprise custom; OSS free

name: Databricks Vector Search
desc: Storage-optimised index scaling to billions of vectors. Hosted MCP servers for UC functions, Genie, Vector Search. Agent framework integrates retrieval with Unity Catalog governance.
deployment: Managed-only
pricing: Pay-per-use DBUs — Standard $0.28/hour per unit (2M 768-dim vectors, 4 DBU/hour); Storage Optimized $1.28/hour per unit (64M vectors, 18.29 DBU/hour), effective

name: Elasticsearch
desc: Mature hybrid (BM25 + vector) implementations. RRF + weighted combination. Elastic ELSER sparse model.
deployment: Both
pricing: free (OSS) self-managed; Elastic Cloud paid (price pages not re-verified)

name: LanceDB
desc: Embedded vector DB (Arrow columnar). RRF reranker. Petabyte-scale on disk.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — embedded OSS library; LanceDB Enterprise as Managed or BYOC
pricing: free (OSS); LanceDB Enterprise/Cloud pricing via sales (no public price list)

name: Marqo
desc: End-to-end multimodal (text + image) vector search via single API. Handles embedding generation internally. Ecommerce personalization with proprietary models.
deployment: Managed-only — commercial Marqo platform; the self-hosted OSS engine is deprecated

name: Milvus
desc: Multi-vector columns (10 simultaneous). Native hybrid search (v2.5). CAGRA + Vamana GPU/CPU (v2.6).
deployment: Both (self-hosted OSS + Zilliz Cloud managed)
pricing: free (OSS); managed via Zilliz Cloud (free tier, then usage-based)

name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
desc: Agent memory store for both short-term (document) and long-term (vector). LangGraph checkpointer for stateful agents. Vector search extended to Community Edition (Sept 2025).
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Atlas managed; Atlas Local deployments with vector search (auto-embedding via Voyage AI)

name: Pinecone
desc: Managed vector DB. Cascading sparse + dense + rerank pipeline; pinecone-rerank-v0 .
deployment: Managed-only — serverless SaaS on AWS/GCP/Azure; BYOC (GA 2026-09) runs in the customer's cloud account
pricing: Starter free (2 GB, 2M WU/1M RU per mo); Builder $20/mo; Standard $50/mo minimum; Enterprise $500/mo minimum

name: Qdrant
desc: Distribution-Based Score Fusion + RRF. Sparse vectors native; filtering via ANN graph modification.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS engine; Qdrant Managed Cloud, Hybrid Cloud and Private Cloud
pricing: Free tier forever (single node, 1 GB RAM / 4 GB disk); Standard usage-based hourly billing; Premium has minimum spend; Hybrid/Private Cloud via sales

name: Snowflake Cortex Search
desc: Hybrid vector + keyword + semantic reranking. Cortex Agents (GA Nov 2025) orchestrate over Cortex Search for unstructured data. No separate vector infra needed inside Snowflake.
deployment: Managed-only

name: Turbopuffer
desc: Object-storage-first vector DB. Powers Notion and Cursor. SPFresh indexing; ~10× cost reduction vs. memory-resident peers.
deployment: Managed-only — multi-tenant cloud; single-tenant and BYOC (in customer cloud) on Enterprise
pricing: Usage-based with monthly minimums: Launch $16/month, Scale $256/month, Enterprise from $4,096/month (35% usage premium); calculator rates storage up to $0.33/GB

name: Vespa
desc: Combines vector ANN, lexical, structured filtering, and ML-learned ranking in one distributed system. Integrated chunking + layered ranking for RAG. No separate embedding infra needed.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS self-hosted; Vespa Cloud (free trial)

name: Weaviate
desc: Hybrid Search 2.0 with learned ranking. BM25 + vector in unified index.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS (Docker/K8s); Weaviate Cloud shared (Free/Flex) and dedicated (Premium)
pricing: Free cluster $0 (100k objects, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk); Flex pay-as-you-go from $45/mo; Premium prepaid via sales; OSS free

name: pgvector
desc: Stores embeddings alongside relational + full-text data. HNSW + IVFFlat ANN indexes. Used as agent conversation memory via LangChain + MCP. Foundation of Supabase AI and many self-hosted RAG stacks.
deployment: Self-hosted only — PostgreSQL extension; also offered inside managed Postgres (Supabase, AWS RDS, Azure, Neon, etc.)
